Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem component.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended): The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem component has a variable length wherein said stem component is adapted to extend from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

Claim 27 (Currently Amended): A glenohumeral joint implant comprising a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and an implant. 

Claim 29 (Currently Amended): A humeral bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem component, wherein said stem component is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone.
